name: YNAB Pulse
author: elevate08
description: Live You Need A Budget pulse in the Omarchy bar with budget progress, spending vs income, age of money, and spending pie charts.

barWidget.description: At-a-glance budget buckets, spending vs income, age of money, and spending breakdown.

schema.label: Refresh interval (hours)
schema.description: How often the background worker fetches updated budget and transaction data from YNAB (default 24h).

schema.label: Show Age of Money in bar
schema.description: Display Age of Money (days) next to the YNAB icon in the status bar pill.

schema.label: Default Budget ID
schema.description: ID of the primary budget to track, or 'last-used' to use the most recently modified budget.
